base.metric_notes: Not official BIRD evaluation. Ignores row order and column aliases; preserves column order and duplicate rows. No answer tolerance. Main accuracy denominator includes every reference record.

additional_metric.name: bird_execution_set_equality
additional_metric.notes: Ignores duplicate rows, row order and column aliases. Preserves column order for non-empty rows. Empty results compare equal even with different column counts. Bounded read-only execution differs from the official harness; see docs/evaluation-protocol.md.
